texto: The **passé simple** reports facts completed in stories, history and literary press. It recognizes frequent forms such as **il entra**, **elle prit**, **ils furent**; in conversation it is usually used the composite passé.

The **passé antérieur** is formed with a simple passet + participle auxiliary: **Quand il eut terminé, il partit**. It marks an action before another story in simple passé. It is a time of reading, not a priority of daily production.

frases.fr: En 1898, l'équipe entra dans la vallée au lever du jour.
frases.es: En 1898, el equipo entró en el valle al amanecer.
frases.en: In 1898, the team entered the valley at dawn.
analisis: the team entered (subject + simple pass of entr in 3rd person singular)
in the valley (preposition dans + noun feminine)
at dawn (temporary location à + le lever de + le jour)

frases.fr: Elle traversa la rivière et découvrit un ancien pont.
frases.es: Cruzó el río y descubrió un puente antiguo.
frases.en: He crossed the river and discovered an old bridge.
analisis: and discovered (conjunction et + simple passé de découvrir)
an old bridge (a qualified adjective opposite + substantive)

frases.fr: Quand le guide eut vérifié la carte, le groupe partit vers le village.
frases.es: Cuando el guía hubo comprobado el mapa, el grupo partió hacia el pueblo.
frases.en: When the guide had checked the map, the group left for the village.
analisis: when the guide had checked (passé antérieur with auxiliary eut in passé simple + particio vérifié)
the group has left (subject + simple passé from leaving)
towards the people (preposition of direction vers)

frases.fr: Le lendemain, les chercheurs racontèrent leur découverte.
frases.es: Al día siguiente, los investigadores contaron su descubrimiento.
frases.en: The next day, the researchers told their discovery.
analisis: the researchers counted (plural subject + simple passé in -èrent de racer)

bloques.pregunta: What did the team find out?

opciones.explicacion: The map was checked, not discovered.
The group left for the village.

bloques.pregunta: What happened first: the check of the letter or the departure?

opciones.texto: The guide checked the letter and then the group left.
The group left before the guide arrived.
Both things happened the next day.
opciones.explicacion: The «lendemain» refers to what they told the story.

bloques.frase: Quand le guide ___ la carte, le groupe partit.
Le lendemain, les chercheurs racontèrent leur découverte.

opciones.texto: The next day, the researchers told their discovery.
The next day, the researchers will tell their discovery.
The investigators discovered the next day.

bloques.pregunta: In a story, what does the simple passé usually point out?

opciones.texto: A finished fact that makes the narrative go forward.
opciones.explicacion: It's a frequent time in written stories.

opciones.texto: A regular action in the present.
opciones.explicacion: This is often expressed with present or imperfect.
A narrative form of the simple passé.

bloques.pregunta: Why is the antérieur passé used in «Quand le guide eut vérifié...»?

opciones.texto: To mark that the check occurred before the departure.

bloques.frase: «Il entra, prit la carte puis partit.»

opciones.texto: A finished action that makes the story go forward.

intro: In some written stories, there are times that are hardly used in conversation; they should be recognized when reading.
